first_failure_what: The first rename implementation built a {new_name: old_name} map and passed it straight to DataFrame.rename(columns=...), which expects {old_name: new_name}, so every rename was a silent no-op. The grouped variant had the same inversion in its group-key lookup. First observed as an AssertionError in the self-written repro at step 21.
